en.t: Repetition had other uses as well.

units.source_text: 譬如，这两个多月来，女人每天投身于家庭手工活：往绳子里穿珠子，连她的脸看起来也有些浮肿了。

en.t: For example, over these past two months and more, the woman had thrown herself every day into piecework at home: stringing beads onto cords, until even her face looked somewhat puffy.

units.source_text: 长长的针尖，时不时像跳舞似的把散落在纸盒底部的铁色珠子捡起来。

en.t: The long needle tip would now and then pick up the iron-colored beads scattered at the bottom of the cardboard box, as if it were dancing.

units.source_text: 不久，存款就有二千日元了。

en.t: Before long, their savings had reached two thousand yen.

units.source_text: 照此下去，再持续半个月，看来就能凑足买收音机的预付款了。

en.t: At this rate, if they kept it up for another half month, it looked as though they could scrape together enough for the down payment on a radio.
